I am a final-year undergraduate student in Computer Science and Engineering at Daffodil International University (DIU),Bangladesh, with a current CGPA of 3.77 / 4.00. I also serve as a Research Assistant at the Health Informatics Research Lab (HIRL), where my research interests include computer vision, deep learning, generative AI, diffusion models, medical image analysis, and image processing.

From October 2024 to September 2025, I completed the Japanese University Studies in Science & Technology (JUSST) academic exchange program at the University of Electro-Communications (UEC), Tokyo, Japan. At the Yanai Laboratory , under the supervision of Prof. Keiji Yanai , I conducted research on BengaliDiff, a diffusion-based framework for few-shot Bengali font generation. This work resulted in a peer-reviewed publication in the ICDAR 2025 Workshops and was presented at ICDAR 2025 in Wuhan, China.

UNDERGRADUATE THESIS · FEBRUARY 2026 – PRESENT

SpectraMoE-MambaNet: A Lightweight Spectral-Spatial Mamba Network with Adaptive Expert Routing for Medical Image Segmentation

Research focus: Developing SpectraMoE-MambaNet, a lightweight spectral-spatial Vision Mamba framework with adaptive expert routing for medical image segmentation, integrating efficient feature fusion and cross-gated attention, with a planned diffusion prior to improve lesion boundary refinement, segmentation robustness, and reliability while preserving computational efficiency.

Supervisor: Dr. Md. Fokhray Hossain · Dean, Faculty of Science & Information Technology (FSIT) & Professor, Department of Computer Science & Engineering (CSE), Daffodil International University (DIU), Bangladesh
